principles.status: Feature definitions/crosswalk considered; no positive implementation from a principle mapping alone.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or replication. This synthesis received full text and earlier image-review notes, not page images directly.

Earlier API calls collectively cover physical pages 1–13, including all figures, tables, references and Appendix/Table V. Their chunk-local missing-page comments do not mean the combined source packet is incomplete.
PDF hash and page-call receipts are supplied provenance, not independently recomputed or inspected. No filesystem writes, software validation or graph admission occurred.

All 128 feature definitions were considered. Necessary auxiliary scopes distinguish observed tracking from imagined identity, explicit FSM semantics from learned-state interpretation, current-depth uncertainty from future uncertainty, and startup withholding from active deferral.

Core identity is supported by own implemented temporal hidden-state/model-policy descriptions and executed control experiments. Cited-system internals, including exact RSSM state, stochasticity, losses and imagined horizon, are not inherited.
The new scope-matched core-identity assertions do not represent new experiments or stronger evidence stages. They expose the same implementation evidence within each L4 evaluation scope.

Exact learned action-input wiring, complete losses, transition distribution, imagined length and direct one-/multi-step predictive fidelity remain insufficiently reported. L4 does not establish separate L1–L3 experiments.
Current-depth uncertainty is engineered. Residual error, calibration and the empirical diameter/interval convention are unresolved.
Score equation/range, third abnormal reward, baseline figure/prose results and generality/robustness language conflict. Both source values are retained rather than corrected by inference.
Table III does not define ±, rollout allocation, aggregation weights or learning-curve variability. No unreported statistical test or confidence interval is invented.
Physical deployment selects the highest simulation-evaluation seed. Physical seed variability, object-instance independence, observer blinding and independent adjudication are not reported.
Physical success combines a human grasp flag and desired gripper height. Independent measured object lift, force, tissue injury and clinical harms are not established.
The 69% result is the 120-episode generality aggregate, not all physical experiments. Thread, background and target-noise subtotal rows must not be counted again.

Human outcome ascertainment is partial E13 evidence, not an established expert/reader/usability study or automatic R4. Synthetic and phantom results do not establish R2 held-out actual human/clinical validation or R6 patient feasibility.
Manual masks, gripper markers, empirical depth settings, partial-visibility assumptions and human FSM identification constrain demonstrated conditions.

Code, weights, license, supplementary video and related publications were not retrieved. Code accessibility/version correspondence is unknown after source-only review; author-stated availability is retained at claim stage.
Potential dependence on prior needle-picking work and later GAS/B052 reporting is unresolved; no independent-study count is certified.
Raw legacy cells are unchanged historical values, not uniformly endorsed current findings. No clinical threshold, regulatory authorization or universal architecture recommendation is inferred.
